blocks.x: The beginner level in marketing strategy and execution training is built on positioning, message architecture, channel fundamentals, and content calendar. The goal is to establish a common language and a practical execution standard within the organization.
Within the first 30–60 days, we aim for clear messaging/themes, consistent content scheduling, and visible improvements in early KPIs (reach–engagement).

items: Positioning Fundamentals: Persona, value proposition, and evidence map.
Message Architecture: Core message, supporting messages, and CTA.
Channel Fundamentals: The role of field, digital, and events.
UTM & Tracking: Simple tagging and campaign tracking.
Reporting & Dashboard: Reach–engagement and CTA performance dashboards.
Templates & Playbook: Message guide, content calendar, and campaign templates.
Risk & Scenario Planning: What‑if and backup plans for reach–engagement–CTA.
Enablement Playbook: Message house, content, and UTM template set.
KPI Glossary (Intro): Standard list of definitions and calculation methods.
Template Access: Quick access to message house and content calendar guides.
